import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open Filter Set TopologicalSpace
open scoped Topology

theorem connected_bounded_trace_prefix
  {α γ δ : Type*} [UniformSpace α] [UniformSpace γ] [UniformSpace δ]
  {A : ℕ → Set α} {f : α → γ} {g : γ → γ} {h : γ → δ}
  (N : ℕ)
  (hA : ∀ n, IsConnected (A n))
  (hOverlap : ∀ n, n < N → (A (n + 1) ∩ ⋃ k ≤ n, A k).Nonempty)
  (hf : UniformContinuous f) (hg : UniformContinuous g) (hh : UniformContinuous h) :
  IsConnected (⋃ n ≤ N, (fun x => (g (f x), h (g (f x)))) '' A n) := by
  classical
  let T : α → γ × δ := fun x => (g (f x), h (g (f x)))
  have hT : Continuous T := by
    dsimp [T]
    exact ((hg.comp hf).prodMk (hh.comp (hg.comp hf))).continuous
  let B : ℕ → Set (γ × δ) := fun n => T '' A n
  have hB : ∀ n, IsConnected (B n) := by
    intro n
    exact (hA n).image T hT.continuousOn
  let U : ℕ → Set (γ × δ) := fun m => ⋃ n ≤ m, B n
  induction N with
  | zero =>
      change IsConnected (U 0)
      simpa [U] using hB 0
  | succ N ih =>
      change IsConnected (U (N + 1))
      have hprev : IsConnected (U N) := by
        apply ih
        intro n hn
        exact hOverlap n (by omega)
      have hw : (U N ∩ B (N + 1)).Nonempty := by
        obtain ⟨x, hxnext, hxprev⟩ := hOverlap N (by omega)
        refine ⟨T x, ?_, ⟨x, hxnext, rfl⟩⟩
        rcases Set.mem_iUnion.mp hxprev with ⟨k, hxprev⟩
        rcases Set.mem_iUnion.mp hxprev with ⟨hk, hxk⟩
        exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr
          ⟨k, Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨hk, ⟨x, hxk, rfl⟩⟩⟩
      have hu : IsConnected (U N ∪ B (N + 1)) :=
        hprev.union hw (hB (N + 1))
      have heq : U (N + 1) = U N ∪ B (N + 1) := by
        ext y
        constructor
        · intro hy
          rcases Set.mem_iUnion.mp hy with ⟨n, hy⟩
          rcases Set.mem_iUnion.mp hy with ⟨hn, hyn⟩
          by_cases hnm : n ≤ N
          · exact Or.inl
              (Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨n, Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨hnm, hyn⟩⟩)
          · have hne : n = N + 1 := by omega
            exact Or.inr (hne ▸ hyn)
        · intro hy
          rcases hy with hy | hy
          · rcases Set.mem_iUnion.mp hy with ⟨n, hy⟩
            rcases Set.mem_iUnion.mp hy with ⟨hn, hyn⟩
            exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr
              ⟨n, Set.mem_iUnion.mpr
                ⟨le_trans hn (Nat.le_succ N), hyn⟩⟩
          · exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr
              ⟨N + 1, Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨le_refl _, hy⟩⟩
      rw [heq]
      exact hu
